scope.source_policy: Catalogs establish provisional scope. Applicable laws use reviewed individual docs; potential unreviewed per-function dimensions are requires_research, not researched contracts.
scope.execution_policy: Implementation scope records opt-in engine policies separately from the default registry. Authoring regeneration does not execute the evaluator; live runtime results are reported separately.
scope.evidence_policy: Case linkages distinguish documented_example, documented_derivation, excel_observation, unresolved; inventory contains no observed Excel or poirot passing claims.
scope.coverage_status: Linked assertions and missing obligations are reported in coverage.json. Historical summary_at_creation is preserved; current scoped capabilities are metadata, not a runtime verification claim.
